data.name: 2hr Sunset Cruise
data.headline: Golden hour on the water
data.description:
Wind down the day with a golden hour cruise aboard BowTie, San Diego’s premier luxury yacht. This 2-hour experience is all about soaking in the skyline, salty air, and glowing sunset from the water.

You’ll cruise past the downtown skyline, Harbor Island, and Shelter Island as the city lights begin to twinkle. Perfect for couples, content shoots, or pre-dinner vibes with friends.

Bring your favorite drinks, snap some golden hour photos, and let the bay do the rest.
data.what_is_included:
Private use of the 80-ft BowTie yacht for 3 hours
Capacity for up to 13 guests
Cruise past downtown San Diego for skyline views
Premium sound system with Bluetooth connection
Deck lounge seating, dance floor, bow sunpads & water access ladder
Bottled water
Onboard crew member for support and safety
